name: CIDR Compass
description: Instant IPv4 subnet answers: network and broadcast address, host range, netmask and wildcard, usable host count, address scope and binary mask. Split a block into smaller subnets, turn a start-end range into CIDR blocks, and check whether an address falls inside a network. Works fully offline, no data ever leaves the browser.
